response.answer: Your record supports writing that you can sustain full workdays when tasks are structured with hourly posture resets and regular ground-level variation. For install work, you can take rotating one-hour scaffold/overhead turns with ground-level tasks between them, but should avoid sustained overhead positions; brief ladder or overhead tasks are within your range. This is supported by your two-year neck-strain log and your physiotherapist’s specific guidance.
